# Synthetic audit fixture: 12-digit AWS account ID inside an ARN.
# The arn:aws prefix and partition/service/region spans are
# canonical-lowercase (AWS ARN spelling), so the capitalized
# spellings below are the same ARNs and must be flagged too; the
# identity is the 12-digit account field.
role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/example"
role_arn_caps = "ARN:AWS:iam::123456789012:role/example"
role_arn_mixed = "Arn:Aws:Ssm:Us-East-1:123456789012:instance/example"
